limits: Static call sites only. Earlier guards or exceptions can prevent execution; their absence is not a proof of idempotence. No replacement payload or edition content is inspected semantically.

targeted_control_flow_review.scope: requested scripts only; static constant branches and directly unreachable statements; no code executed
methods: Literal truth values, boolean short-circuit truth and safe literal comparisons only.
Empty literal for iterables and statements directly following unconditional return, raise, break or continue in the same block.
No symbol propagation, runtime evaluation, semantic replacement review or execution.

rerun_findings.append_calls: Six requested apply scripts contain module-level append-helper calls with no enclosing conditional. They append if reached; earlier failures may stop a rerun first. No general idempotence claim is made.

front_record_updater.limitation: A normal rerun after a successful insertion is rejected by the assertion; optimized execution disables assertions. No claim is made about arbitrary prior file states.
